steps.en: Download the msi, dmg, or rpm/deb installer from GitHub Releases and install it
steps.zh: 从 Releases 下载 msi、dmg 或 rpm／deb 安装包装好

steps.en: Add a ZooKeeper server connection, optionally through an SSH tunnel
steps.zh: 添加 ZooKeeper 连接，需要时走 SSH 隧道

steps.en: Connects via Apache Curator, loads the znode tree and keeps it synced live
steps.zh: 通过 Apache Curator 连上，加载 znode 树并实时同步

steps.en: Click a node to read or edit its data, create or delete nodes, set ACLs
steps.zh: 点开节点读写数据、增删节点、设置 ACL

steps.en: Pretty-prints and highlights JSON/XML data and writes your edits back
steps.zh: 把 JSON／XML 数据格式化高亮，并把你的改动写回集群

value.en: You see and fix what is in ZooKeeper by clicking, without memorizing zkCli.sh commands
value.zh: 点几下就能看清、改掉 ZooKeeper 里的内容，不用背 zkCli.sh 命令

sources: https://github.com/vran-dev/PrettyZoo README "What" (GUI created by JavaFX and Apache Curator Framework; Release installers: Windows (msi), Mac (dmg), Linux (rpm & deb))

https://github.com/vran-dev/PrettyZoo README "Feature" (multi-server manage, real-time node synchronize, ACL, SSH tunnel, node create/search/update/delete, terminal operation, JSON/XML pretty format, auto reconnect)
